sites.name: The Hollow Keep
sites.rule: Steal together. Escape through the golden arch.
sites.lore: Their watch has outlived the kings they served.

sites.name: The Glass Below
sites.rule: Walls vanish from sight, never from the world.
sites.lore: The stone remembers the road. Will you?

sites.name: The Cinder Choir
sites.rule: Hatched stone warns of fire. Wait for the breath to pass.
sites.lore: Here even silence has been taught to burn.

sites.name: The Hours Unwound
sites.rule: Arrows announce a shift. Every turning leaves a road.
sites.lore: The halls obey no hour but their master’s.

sites.name: The Moonwell
sites.rule: An immediate full heal and one team ward. Single use.
sites.lore: A kindness sleeps where the moon cannot reach.

sites.name: The Lost Bell
sites.rule: Rescue the fallen keeper for a heal and a team ward.
sites.lore: One last bell still waits for a living hand.

sites.name: The Last Binding
sites.rule: Bind four recovered rings. Flee when the last seal sings.
sites.lore: No blade can kill what the Ringmaster dreams.

rooms.name: The Courtyard of Small Courage
rooms.text: Two roads, one promise. Carry the practice ring to the golden arch. Your companion will follow.

rooms.name: I · The Oathgate
rooms.text: Sentries need not die. Make a window, then take the far arch.

rooms.name: II · The King’s Empty Hand
rooms.text: Take the Oath ring. Its light will summon pursuit. The way home is the way you came.

rooms.name: III · The Remembering Vein
rooms.text: The ribs of glass fade, then shine again. Nearby edges remain visible. A Phantom can wake every hidden seam.

rooms.name: IV · The Mirror Reliquary
rooms.text: Shadows on the floor foretell the falling spiders. Carry Memory out of the glass.

rooms.name: V · The Breath Between
rooms.text: Hatching is warning; white stone is refuge. Fire passes in breaths. Stonewalk and Mirrorcloak cannot protect you from lava.

rooms.name: VI · The Cinder Choir
rooms.text: Let the furnace sing before you cross. A ward stills a flame lane; every hero can wait for its silence.

rooms.name: VII · The March of Walls
rooms.text: The floor arrows speak before the walls move. Stand clear; the turning always leaves another path.

rooms.name: VIII · The Hour Unmade
rooms.text: Wings do not respect the walls. The Turning ring must leave this place in living hands.

rooms.name: The Moonwell
rooms.text: Touch the sleeping well, then return. Its kindness is spent only once.

rooms.name: The Lost Bell
rooms.text: Hold beside the fallen keeper. A saved life shall lighten your own.

rooms.name: IX · The Last Binding
rooms.text: The dragon cannot die. Read its breath. Bind the four rings at their stations; then escape together.
